description: This Java source file defines the RMIExtendedSocketFactory class which extends RMISocketFactory. It provides custom socket creation methods for RMI, allowing sockets to be bound to a specific network interface or IP address, specified either as InetAddress or as a string IP address.

classes.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
classes.description: A custom implementation of RMISocketFactory that creates server sockets bound to a specific network interface or IP address, facilitating network interface-specific RMI communication.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Default constructor that binds to all network interfaces.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an InetAddress to bind sockets to a specific network interface.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a string representing an IP address, parsing it into an InetAddress.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.description: Creates a ServerSocket bound to the specified port, optionally bound to a specific network interface if provided.

methods.name: createSocket
methods.description: Creates a client Socket connected to the specified host and port.
